news.title: Full year 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹0.23 (vs ₹0.88 loss in FY 2025)
news.body: Full year 2026 results: EPS: ₹0.23 (up from ₹0.88 loss in FY 2025). Revenue: ₹132.0m (up 116% from FY 2025). Net income: ₹57.6m (up ₹281.4m from FY 2025). Profit margin: 44% (up from net loss in FY 2025). Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 125% per year but the company’s share price has only increased by 40% per year, which means it is significantly lagging earnings growth.

news.title: High number of new and inexperienced directors
news.body: There are 7 new directors who have joined the board in the last 3 years. The company's board is composed of: 7 new directors. No experienced directors. 1 highly experienced director. Non-Executive Independent Director Mariappanadar Pandian is the most experienced director on the board, commencing their role in 2018. The following issues are considered to be risks according to the Simply Wall St Risk Model: Lack of board continuity. Lack of experienced directors.

news.title: Sri Adhikari Brothers Television Network Limited Appoints Srivatsava Sunkara as Chairperson, Effective January 6, 2026
news.body: Sri Adhikari Brothers Television Network Limited, in its meeting held on January 6, 2026, approved the appointment of Srivatsava Sunkara as Chairperson of the Company, effective January 6, 2026, as disclosed in the company's regulatory filings. Sunkara brings extensive experience in Artificial Intelligence and the development of Large Language Models (LLMs), with a proven track record of transforming organisational operations to enhance efficiency and foster innovation. He has no familial or professional relationship with any existing directors of the Company and is not debarred from holding the office of director by any order of SEBI or other authorities.

news.title: Sri Adhikari Brothers Television Network Limited Announces Resignation of Kiran Kumar Inampudi as Chairperson, Effective January 6, 2026
news.body: Sri Adhikari Brothers Television Network Limited announced that Mr. Kiran Kumar Inampudi resigned from the position of Chairperson of the board, effective from January 6, 2026. He will continue serving as an Executive Director, contributing actively to the Board. He has confirmed that there are no material reasons for his resignation other than mentioned in his resignation letter.
